comparisons.scheme1_value: Crop insurance — protects farmers financially against crop loss from natural disasters, pests, and diseases.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Financial inclusion — provides basic banking services and access to credit, insurance, and pensions for unbanked adults.

comparisons.scheme1_value: All farmers (including tenant farmers and sharecroppers) growing notified crops in notified areas.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Indian nationals, especially weaker sections and low-income groups without bank accounts. Minors above 10 years can also apply with guardian support.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Affordable crop insurance (farmer pays 1.5–5% premium, government subsidies rest); covers natural disasters, pests, diseases, post-harvest losses (14 days), and localised calamities; prevented-sowing cover (25% of sum insured); claims within 2 months.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Free basic savings account with no minimum balance; free RuPay debit card with Rs. 2 lakh accident insurance; overdraft facility up to Rs. 10,000; banking access via branches, ATMs, and Bank Mitras in rural areas.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Farmer pays 2% for Kharif food & oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi food & oilseeds, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops. In North-Eastern States, J&K, and Himachal Pradesh, government pays entire premium.
comparisons.scheme2_value: No account opening fees; no minimum balance; free debit card. Only transaction-based costs may apply (e.g., ATM withdrawals beyond limit).

comparisons.scheme1_value: Passport-size photo, bank passbook, identity proof (Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID/NREGA job card), address proof (Aadhaar/electricity bill/bank passbook), and land records (RoR/LPC or state-permitted agreements).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Aadhaar, government ID proof (Voter Card/PAN/Ration Card), address proof (Passport/Driving Licence/electricity/telephone/water bill), passport-size photo, filled/signed account-opening form, and any document notified by Central Government.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Online via pmfby.gov.in — register as guest farmer, fill details, upload documents, make payment, track status. Offline and CSC application also available.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Offline at nearest bank branch — download account-opening form from pmjdy.gov.in, fill it manually, visit branch with documents and mobile number/email. Portal provides form and information only.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Seasonal cut-off — apply within ~2 weeks of sowing season start (exact dates notified per state on pmfby.gov.in). Missing deadline means no cover for that season.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Open-ended — accounts can be opened anytime throughout the year.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Non-notified areas not covered; losses outside crop cycle excluded; negligence or non-compliance with recommended practices rejected; post-harvest cover only 14 days in cut-and-spread condition; non-payment cancels coverage.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Small Account expires after 12 months unless proof of valid ID application shown; BSBDA allows only 4 cash withdrawals/month; RuPay accident cover subject to card-usage conditions.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers' Welfare).
Covers over 50 crore farmers and 50+ crops.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Universal coverage for unbanked adults across India through bank branches, ATMs, and Bank Mitras.

recommendation: These are **complementary, not competing schemes** designed for different needs: **PMFBY is for farmers needing crop insurance protection** against agricultural losses due to weather, pests, or diseases. **PMJDY is for anyone (farmer or non-farmer) needing basic banking access** to save money, build credit history, and access financial services. A farmer can benefit from **both schemes**: PMJDY provides the bank account needed to pay PMFBY premiums and receive claim payouts, while PMFBY protects the farmer's income from crop loss. **Choose PMFBY if:** You are a farmer growing notified crops and want financial protection against crop damage. **Choose PMJDY if:** You don't have a bank account and want access to basic savings, credit, insurance, and remittances. **⚠️ Disclaimer:** This is AI guidance based on official scheme information. Always verify details at pmfby.gov.in and pmjdy.gov.in, and consult your nearest bank or agriculture department for final decisions.
note: Information sourced from official PMFBY and PMJDY portals and scheme documentation. Confidence: High for factual details; always cross-check with official sources for eligibility and current dates.
